name: Scroll-Locked Video Hero
description: Pre-rendered video scrubbed by scroll. Body is locked so the page cannot move. Title blurs out at 35%, tagline fades in at 82%. Every constant is tuned by hand.
when_to_use: Cinematic hero with a 4-6s pre-rendered video asset. Best for automotive, luxury, product reveals.
not_for: Text-heavy editorial pages, dashboards, pages with no video asset.
